review.notes: Full review of a README-only revision (attributions to seven further texts, ten renamed headings; statements and Suggested.lean unchanged). Previous review had no finding. Automatic checks pass (rerun), dependency check 0 problems, Suggested.lean elaborates with 70 sorry warnings only, one-tactic padding probe closes none of the 70 theorems, 36 library declarations opened at the pins, cross-roadmap citations and cited anchors resolved. One small correction (attribution in 2.5), two format notes, two questions; one source error recorded (DLMF 12.13.5, already corrected in 8.3).
